verdict.rationale: First-party docs show you can define your own functions as custom tools for Claude to call, exposed through the SDK's in-process MCP server (docs-8, docs-47). An agent is configured through a single optional options object on `query()` (docs-48, docs-54), and the GitHub README shows a minimal `query()` loop in a few lines (gh-2). missing for 10: explicit evidence that tool inputs are typed or schema-validated (e.g. typed parameter definitions), a concise end-to-end custom-tool code sample, independent or hands-on corroboration.
